content.content: When invoked as `deccy record` with an argument the form does not name — an unknown flag, `--to` without its value, or a second `--to` — the deccy CLI shall refuse the invocation, naming the argument.
content.rationale: The form names one `--to <id>` and its positional paths, so an argument shaped like a flag but naming nothing the form names cannot be honoured; guessing at it would record edits from an invocation the caller did not write. Naming the argument keeps the refusal actionable without re-deciding the form.
